name: Meghalaya Dairy Development Scheme
benefit: 1. Credit linkage through partnered banks 1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 24 months 1. Veterinary and farm management support 1. Mentorship and business advisory 1. 50% of project cost supported (5% by applicant, 45% by Government) 1. Market linkage for selling output 1. Technical training and capacity building
_eligibility_text: **Individuals** 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The entrepreneur should possess land, either self-owned or on lease, verified by the competent authority. 1. The entrepreneur should possess a training certificate on the sector applied for from a recognized Institution, preferably from a Government Institute. 1. The Preference for availing loans will be given to entrepreneurs and entities with prior experience of undertaking dairy. 1. The entrepreneur should have access to adequate and quality feed for the cattle. 1. The entrepreneur should have a vaccination Scheme in place for the cattle. 1. The entrepreneur should have a plan for marketing the dairy products. 1. The entrepreneurs village should be in an area where dairy farming is feasible. 1. The distance between the entrepreneur’s village and the nearest market must be reasonable. 1. The entrepreneur should not be a credit defaulter from any bank. **Registered Entities** 1. Any group/entity registered in Meghalaya such as Cooperatives, Farmer Producer Companies (FPC), Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) and so on 1. Must provide an Incorporation Certificate or a registration certificate whichever is applicable 1. At least two members should possess a training certificate on the sector applied for from a recognized institution, preferably from a government institute 1.
